_comment: Known-good single-object side-grip grasp, dumped from a real successful MuJoCo grasp cycle. Isaac replays it deterministically: set base -> force ALL these arm-1 joints (incl passive linkage) -> object sits at object_xyz -> close. No IK, no LUT. 2026-07-23b: box-clearing grasp WITHIN joint limits — columns h1 0.285/dh 0.11, boom a1 0.44, HandBearing re-tuned (orientation diff 0.001, finger cage shift <0.2mm, palm z exact). Carriages 0.651/0.761 > chassis-box top 0.635; ArmRight -0.489 vs limit -0.525 (first attempt used a1 0.597 -> ArmRight -0.619 PAST the limit -> kinematic limit-fight shoved the base ~2m every reach). 2026-07-23c: columns +0.01 (pure z raise) — the gripper UNDERSIDE (Gripper_Link3 min z 0.270) sat 6mm INSIDE the object top (0.276); now it clears by ~4mm so the hand rests just above the object while the fingers pinch the rim/upper side (the same top-grasp geometry as the working MuJoCo close).
close_note: per-finger force-stop: close each finger until normal force N >= N_req = safety*mass*g/(mu*3), then freeze that finger at contact qpos; others keep closing. verify = opposing pinch (thumb-a vs b/c).
